title_zh: 军旅剧：训练场上的汗水
title_en: Chinese TV Dramas (10/20): Sweat on the Training Ground
note_en: 一遍又一遍 (yíbiàn yòu yíbiàn) means "over and over": 一遍又一遍地练习动作 "drill the moves over and over." 遍 is a measure word for complete run-throughs of an action, and repeating 一遍 with 又 ("again") in between stresses the endless repetition. The same frame works with other measure words: 一次又一次 "time after time," 一天又一天 "day after day."
